# Test fixtures

All files here are **synthetic samples** shaped like NSE / AMC / Angel One
data, for offline tests. Names such as "Sample Director One" and "SAMPLE
CAPITAL FUND" are made up, and the numbers are illustrative. The ISINs,
symbols and Angel One tokens are the real public identifiers of those
companies, so lookups behave as they would on live data.

The AMC portfolio workbooks are generated by `tests/build_fixtures.py`.
